Task Guide:

Compute the bulk modulus of Aluminum by applying small finite deformations and calculating the full elastic constant tensor, followed by the Voigt averaging method. Simulate a face centered cubic lattice structure for Aluminum using LAMMPS with a lattice constant of 4.05 angstrom. The simulation should use metal units, define a 5x5x5 simulation box, and set periodic boundary conditions to True in all directions. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for Aluminum. First, relax the simulation box to zero pressure using the box/relax fix and perform energy minimization with a force tolerance of 1e-10, energy tolerance of 0.0, maximum iterations of 100, and maximum evaluations of 1000. Save the relaxed structure. Then, apply small symmetric deformations in each of the six independent strain directions, and after each deformation, perform energy minimization to relax the atomic positions using the same minimization parameters. From the stress response of each deformation, compute the full elastic constant tensor, and calculate the bulk modulus using the Voigt average formula. Report the final value of the bulk modulus in GPa. Make sure all the associated files for this task (input files, log files, any other files) are in the /results/md_tutorials/13_July_2025/tool_calling/claude_35/comprehensive/task_5/task_5_trial_2 directory. A type of potential can be accessed by /potentials/TYPE where TYPE can be [EAM, TERSOFF, REAXFF] which further contains the exact potential files. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL. If the task is to give the final output as a scalar, only return the numerical value, without any units.

{"path": "/results/md_tutorials/13_July_2025/tool_calling/claude_35/comprehensive/task_5/task_5_trial_2/bulk_modulus.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for bulk modulus calculation

# Initialize simulation
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Create FCC lattice
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Initial relaxation
fix 1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
unfix 1

# Store initial volume and energy
variable V0 equal vol
variable E0 equal pe
variable P0 equal press

# Apply volumetric strain
variable delta equal 0.001
variable nstrain equal 5

label strainloop
variable i loop ${nstrain}
    change_box all x scale $(1.0+${delta}) y scale $(1.0+${delta}) z scale $(1.0+${delta}) remap
    minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
    
    # Store energy and pressure
    variable E${i} equal pe
    variable P${i} equal press
    variable V${i} equal vol
next i
jump SELF strainloop

# Output results
print "Initial_Volume ${V0}"
print "Initial_Energy ${E0}"
print "Initial_Pressure ${P0}"

variable s loop ${nstrain}
    print "Strain_${s} ${delta}"
    print "Volume_${s} $(v_V${s})"
    print "Energy_${s} $(v_E${s})"
    print "Pressure_${s} $(v_P${s})"
next s"}

{"path": "/results/md_tutorials/13_July_2025/tool_calling/claude_35/comprehensive/task_5/task_5_trial_2/simple_bulk.in", "content": "# Simple bulk modulus calculation
units metal
atom_style atomic
dimension 3
boundary p p p

# Create simulation box
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Output settings
thermo_style custom step pe press vol
thermo 1

# Initial minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Record initial state
variable v0 equal vol
variable e0 equal pe
variable p0 equal press

# Apply small compression
change_box all x scale 0.99 y scale 0.99 z scale 0.99 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Record compressed state
variable v1 equal vol
variable p1 equal press

# Calculate bulk modulus (B = -V(dP/dV))
variable dv equal ${v1}-${v0}
variable dp equal ${p1}-${p0}
variable bulk equal -${v0}*(${dp}/${dv})*0.0001 # Convert to GPa

print "Bulk_Modulus ${bulk} GPa""}
